verdict.rationale: PagerDuty ships an official local and hosted MCP server (verified live via probe returning correct auth challenge) that exposes PagerDuty's incident/on-call tools to any MCP-enabled client, letting AI-native users issue natural-language commands (e.g., via Slack, IDE, or LLM assistants) to trigger/ack/resolve incidents and manage on-call data. This is reinforced by PagerDuty Advance and SRE Agent messaging around agentic/generative AI operating the platform. Missing for 10: no first-party native chat/NL interface within the PagerDuty product itself (reliant on external MCP clients) and no independent hands-on account of a user issuing NL commands end-to-end.
